:1. `--api-key` — must be an `sk_` key. A `mcpjam_…` legacy key is a usage error.\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/cli.md:109:Every command
that can contact MCPJam (it accepts `--api-url`, or it uploads results) decides its server when it starts, before it contacts any
thing. An explicit `--api-url`, `MCPJAM_API_URL` or `MCPJAM_BASE_URL` that is not an `http(s)` URL, or that carries credentials, a
query or a fragment, is a usage error (exit `2`), and so are the two variables naming different servers. The error masks credenti
als, a query and a fragment, and does not repeat a value that is not a URL. A saved login is only sent to its own server: when it
is the credential and the order picks another server, the command exits `3` before any request. `mcpjam cloud status` uses the sam
e checks but stays network-free: it still emits the complete JSON report, sets `ok: false`, includes `credential.valid` / `deploym
ent.valid` plus an `error` string, and exits `1`. Missing credentials are informational (`credential.valid: null`) and successful.

pi.md:795:`anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5` — and runs on your organization's credits.\n36:## Usage limits\n38:The hosted app uses a da
ily credit system to power AI features like chat.\n40:* **Guests** get a free daily usage allowance. Higher-priced models are grey
ed out in the model picker with a \"Sign in to use this model\" tooltip — sign in to unlock them. The sidebar shows a progress bar
with how much of your daily limit you've used and when it resets. When you reach the limit, you'll be prompted to sign in.\n42:*
**Signed-in users** get **10×** the daily usage of a guest. Your daily usage and any paid credit balance are visible in the accoun
t menu at the bottom of the sidebar.\n43:* **Paid credits** can be topped up from the billing page and are shown alongside your da
ily limit in the account menu.\n44:* **Low credits warning** — when your credit balance drops to 10% or below, the sidebar credit
meter turns red and shows a **Low credits** label.\n45:* **When credits run out**, only the free hosted models are locked. Models
you access with your own API key (BYOK) remain available regardless of your credit balance.\n47:When your credit balance reaches z
ero, free models are grayed out in the model picker so you can see the limit before sending a message. Models from your own API ke
ys remain available. If you have paid top-up credits, free models stay enabled even after your daily free allowance is exhausted.\
n51:Open the **account menu** at the bottom of the sidebar (click your avatar or email) and choose **Sign out**. You'll be returne
d to the public app as a guest, and any signed-in usage allowance is replaced by the guest allowance until you sign back in.\n106:
## Billing\n110:The **Payment history** card on the org billing page lists your recent credit top-ups. Each row shows:\n121:To add
credits, click **Top up** — either from the empty state when you have no history, or from the credit balance card above.\n125:> *
*Free plan organizations cannot purchase credits directly.** If your organization is on the Free plan, the Top up dialog shows a m
essage that only an organization owner can upgrade the plan, with a **Compare plans** button. Clicking it closes the dialog and op
ens your organization's Plans settings so you can upgrade.\n129:> **Desktop app:** When you confirm a top-up in the desktop app, c
heckout opens in your default system browser and the dialog closes automatically. Your credit balance updates in the app once the
